description:
ERC-8004 agents by ladder step, by advertised tool and method counts, and most recently indexed.

Ranked lists — by four-step ladder position, by MCP tool count, by OpenAPI method count (what an agent lists, not what it can do), and most-recently indexed — each with agent_id, chain, public name, a shareable detail URL, and the relevant count. Names and counts only: no owner wallets, handles, or endpoint URLs.

Paid counterpart: `GET /v1/intel/trending` (x402, USDC on base-mainnet) returns trending intel — top earners, fastest-rising agents, and integration candidates ranked with the signals behind the ranking. Every response from this free tool carries an `unlock` block with the exact paid endpoint, price, and payment discovery.
name: get_leaderboards
